item.title: Essex at 7, Friday 27 November: c2c gets £2m plan to fix delays, with night and weekend works in December
item.description: The Seax morning briefing for Friday 27 November.
item.content:encoded:
Weather

Cloudy, high 5°C, low 2°C, 20% chance of rain.

The stories that matter

c2c gets £2m plan to fix delays, with night and weekend works in December

Southend-on-Sea, Basildon, Upminster · Rail bosses are spending more to fix the Southend line after months of delays. Some December trains will finish early or be replaced by buses.

Frosty start across Essex before a raw Friday and milder weekend

Essex · Clear spells tonight bring a frost by dawn. Friday stays cold and grey, before rain and milder air arrive on Saturday.

Tube strike: Essex commuters face a late start and limited lines on Friday

Essex · The Tube drivers' walkout runs until midday on Friday. Central line users in Epping Forest face another disrupted journey.

Harlow Council tells government to drop asylum plan for private homes

Harlow · The Home Office's contractor wants to rent homes across Harlow for asylum seekers. The council's leader wants the plan dropped.

Southend's Lazydays adds Ella Eyre, KT Tunstall and Pixie Lott for 2027

Southend, Priory Park · Sigala, Daniel Bedingfield and Celebrity Traitors winner Bash Croft are also on the biggest line-up announcement yet for the Priory Park festival, which returns in July 2027.

Cocaine kingpin who sent couriers to Harwich and Southend jailed for 18 years

Harwich · Bradley Stainer ran a network that moved more than a tonne of cocaine. His couriers were paid more than £1,000 a day.

Great Waltham concert to fund generators for Ukraine's winter

Great Waltham · Ukrainian accordionist Igor Saienko plays the village church on 9 December. Entry is free, with donations going to a Felsted charity which helps fund generators for Ukraine.

Southend United legend Frankie Banks given Freedom of the City

Southend-on-Sea · The former Shrimpers full-back started the club's community work in 1991. The club says his impact goes far beyond the pitch.

From Council Watch

Braintree plans £7m for leisure centres and £600,000 on homelessness

Braintree District Council · Braintree's first budget plans for 2027-28 promise no cuts to services. A gap of £542,000 still has to be closed.

NHS agrees to face Maldon councillors over Southminster health hub

Maldon District Council · Councillors are worried about slow progress on a planned medical centre in Southminster. The local NHS has agreed to answer their questions.

Maldon drafts guide to curb dust and noise from building sites

Maldon District Council · Councillors want builders to plan better for dust, noise and debris. A new guide goes to a committee on 3 December.

Travel

  • Wickford: Runwell Road shut for roadworks to 2 Dec; First Essex 13, 13A, 13B and X10 miss The Swans and Wickford station
  • Wickford: Station Approach shut 28 to 29 Nov; First Essex 13, 13A, 13B and X10 divert
  • Chelmsford: Melbourne Avenue shut 8pm to 5am from 30 Nov to 2 Dec for roadworks; First Essex C2 and C3 divert
  • Elizabeth line: no trains between Paddington and Shenfield on 28 and 29 Nov; buses Shenfield to Newbury Park

On today

  • The Grinch Christmas Quest, Saffron Walden town centre · Free
  • Enchanted Trail of Light, Colchester Zoo, Colchester
  • The Santa Express at Lakeside, Lakeside Shopping Centre, Grays
  • Light Up Leigh, Leigh Community Centre and Leigh Library Gardens · Free

Essex commuters face Tube strike from midday as Acas talks fail

Southend, Basildon and Thurrock · c2c topped Britain's punctuality table last spring. This autumn, just over half its stops have been on time. We look at why.

Essex energy bills to rise 26% in January as price cap hits £2,166

Essex · Homes across Essex on standard tariffs face dearer gas and electricity from New Year's Day. The regulator blames conflict in the Middle East.

M25 delays ease after crash just past A127 junction near Upminster

M25, Upminster · A collision at about 6.45pm held traffic heading for Thurrock. Queues had cleared by about 7.25pm.

Southend: four masked men attack man who refused to hand over money

Southend, Clifftown Road · A man in his 30s was left with rib and neck injuries. Police want to hear from anyone who saw what happened.

Braintree plans £7m for leisure centres and £600,000 on homelessness

NHS agrees to face Maldon councillors over Southminster health hub

item.title: Essex at 7, Wednesday 25 November: Essex student Moyin Odeniran wins The Great British Bake Off

item.content:encoded:
Weather

Cloudy, high 7°C, low 0°C, 30% chance of rain.

The stories that matter

Essex student Moyin Odeniran wins The Great British Bake Off

Loughton · The 22-year-old beat Tom Whittaker and Mo Mahir in the Channel 4 final on Tuesday 24 November, with friends and family watching at his local church in Loughton.

Hanningfield Reservoir hits record low of 35% as hosepipe ban goes on

Hanningfield, Chelmsford · Hanningfield, near Chelmsford, is at its lowest level on record. It would normally be about twice as full at this time of year.

Basildon Hospital gas and air halt 'completely unacceptable', says midwife union

Basildon · The RCM says Basildon Hospital has had years to make gas and air safe for staff. Women in labour are offered alternative pain relief.

Maldon Local Plan consultation now open: have your say

Maldon · People across Maldon district can say what its next plan for homes and roads should cover. Views close on 22 December.

Maldon house prices up 5% in a year as Tendring's fall 2.2%

Essex · Official September figures show a county split in two. Prices rose in nine Essex areas and fell in five.

Billericay chip pan fire leaves resident with burned hands

Billericay · A Billericay resident was hurt in a kitchen fire. Firefighters say never move a burning pan.

Cold Norton: police find £300,000 cannabis farm in barn

Cold Norton · Officers found more than 500 plants near Cold Norton after a tip-off. Police say grows like this can be linked to modern slavery.

Hatfield Peverel man, 26, jailed for five years for sexual assaults

Hatfield Peverel · David Cooney is now on the sex offenders' register. The woman he assaulted says she finally has closure.

South Essex father jailed for abusing his two vulnerable children

Basildon Crown Court · Detectives showed him video of what he had done, and a judge called it "gratuitous degradation". The children's mother, who delayed telling police, was given a community order.

QEII bridge reopens after police incident adds to a torrid day at Dartford

Thurrock · Everything was open again by 6.20pm, but drivers going both ways faced hours of queues, and more overnight closures follow this week.

Stansted Airport tests its plane crash response today with 400 people

Weather

Sunny, high 8°C, low 1°C, 40% chance of rain.

A12 northbound partly reopens at Chelmsford after crash

Firefighters pump floodwater away from five Warley homes

Maldon Salt labelling questions passed to Essex Trading Standards

Former Ravens store in Southend could become 17-room shared house

Southend-on-Sea, Clifftown Road · The developer wants to drop a students-only rule on rooms above the old Clifftown Road store, opposite Southend Central station.

Brentwood School coach Gareth Stafford Bull likely abused pupils, review finds

Brentwood · The school's own independent review says the fencing coach probably harmed a number of boys through the 1980s and 1990s, and that former pupils who came forward years later were brushed off. British Fencing is now…

Essex anti-social behaviour reports up 76% as robbery falls 19%

Essex · The Seax analysis of police.uk data shows anti-social behaviour reports rose in 50 of Essex Police's 56 neighbourhood areas in September 2026 compared with September 2025, with Basildon recording the most.

Frosty Friday night for Essex with lows of -1C, then a bright Saturday

Essex · Freezing fog patches could slow early journeys on Saturday morning, and another cold night follows on Sunday. No Met Office weather warning is in force.

Dispersal order and face-covering powers at RAF Wethersfield this weekend

Wethersfield · Essex Police say the order, from 8am on Saturday to midnight on Monday, is to keep emergency access to the site open while allowing lawful protest.

Shrimpers lose five-goal table-top thriller

Southend-on-Sea · Tyreece Simpson and debutant Rico Richards struck two minutes apart after the break, but the Shrimpers could not complete the comeback against the runaway leaders.

Two taken to hospital after A282 crash shuts QEII Bridge for hours

Thurrock · Both were taken by road to the Royal London Hospital, and more closures are planned at the Dartford Crossing tonight and on Saturday.

Basildon man, 49, not heard from for weeks as police appeal for help

Basildon · Essex Police are concerned for the welfare of Valeriy Hurynchuk, 49, from Basildon, who has not been in contact for several weeks, the Echo reports.

Greater Anglia trains to Stansted Airport hit by signalling failure

Stansted · A signalling fault caused hours of disruption for Greater Anglia passengers travelling to and from Stansted Airport on the evening of Friday 20 November, the Daily Gazette reports.

Tendring plans to backdate council tax support for working-age claimants

Tendring council runs £3.9m under budget at half-year, mainly on timing

Tendring District Council · Tendring District Council says the gap mainly reflects when money is spent and received across several budgets.

Maldon council to decide on 25-year River Blackwater foreshore leases

Maldon District Council · A boatyard business near Downs Road in Maldon uses two council-owned stretches of foreshore for access. Officers say it has a legal right to renew.

item.title: Essex at 7, Friday 20 November: Pitsea man jailed over gunpowder as judge says ChatGPT fed his fears

Weather

Mist, high 9°C, low -1°C, 40% chance of rain.

The stories that matter

Pitsea man jailed over gunpowder as judge says ChatGPT fed his fears

Pitsea, Basildon · The Pitsea man said he was getting ready to protect his family in a 'post-apocalyptic scenario'. He was sentenced at Basildon Crown Court for illegally having explosive powder.

Frosty Friday night for Essex with lows of -1C, then a bright Saturday

Essex · Freezing fog patches could slow early journeys on Saturday morning, and another cold night follows on Sunday. No Met Office weather warning is in force.

Grays scrapyard fire put out, crews stay to check for hotspots

Grays · About 20 firefighters tackled the fire in Towers Road. Its smoke drifted across the town, and neighbours were told to keep windows shut.

Braintree MP Cleverly wins 86% of Tory vote to run for London mayor

Braintree · Braintree's Conservatives must now find a new parliamentary candidate after their MP beat two rivals in a ballot of London party members.

c2c signalling fault near Barking disrupts trains on all routes

Southend-on-Sea, Grays, Basildon · Passengers between Shoeburyness, Southend, Grays and London Fenchurch Street faced cancellations and delays of up to 20 minutes on the afternoon of Thursday 19 November.

Essex Police arrest 17 in week-long county lines crackdown

Essex · Eleven people were charged and remanded, and officers seized 22 throwing blades, a zombie knife, drugs and cash.

Basildon council homes audit cannot confirm hazards were fixed

Basildon · An independent check of Basildon Council's 11,790 homes found no council-wide system for tracking hazards such as damp, mould and cold, months after the housing regulator gave it the lowest grade.

Basildon council tenants face up to £1 a week extra rent from April

Basildon · The charge, on top of the usual inflation-linked rise, would grow to up to £2 a week each year from April 2028 until rents reach the government's formula level.

Basildon Council heads for £3.8m overspend as homelessness costs rise

Cloudy, high 9°C, low 5°C, 80% chance of rain.

The stories that matter

Driver jailed for 81mph Theydon Bois crash that killed pedestrian

M11 southbound stays shut near Stansted overnight after lorry crash

Stansted, M11 · National Highways said the motorway between Saffron Walden and Stansted Airport would stay closed through Wednesday evening and into the night, with no reopening time.

Southend council leadership challenge fails by two votes

Southend-on-Sea · Southend-on-Sea City Council's leader keeps the post after a narrow vote, the Yellow Advertiser reports.

Hanningfield Reservoir 35% full as Essex drought runs into winter
